description: Archived reference-implementation DCT five-fold numbers for BLCA, taken from the legacy validation folds (per-fold validation C-index peak). These are NOT re-run by this comparison; they are loaded read-only and aggregated with the same mean+/-std rule as every other arm.

protocol.selection: maximum validation Harrell C per fold
protocol.split_family: 5fold (dataset_splits_summary/uni), i.e. the UNI v1 split set

limits: These are the reference implementation's own archived numbers, not a re-run under this repository's code.
Each fold value is a validation-selected peak, so it is optimistically biased in the same way as the arms compared against it.

The archived IBS/IAUC were produced under the historical metric time grid; the arms compared here are also reported under that grid, but the grid itself was audited as time-misaligned and must not be read as a calibrated error score.
The reference implementation's own outer-test five-fold numbers are a different evaluation protocol and are not comparable to this table.
